title: When People stop listening
author: Ranu Uniyal
text:
Crocuses bloom.
The eyelids drop
unable to bear
a single note of diffidence.
The sun is soft
this mid-summer May
as ashes bring
bodies home.
And we put them on
our tinted glasses
revealing little or nothing
woes on hold.
Aconites shrill.
The earbuds wilt
words deflate
and all is still.
